title: Jesus! Delightful, Charming Name
description: Jesus! Delightful, Charming Name in Tonic Solfa to ST. AGNES, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Benjamin Beddome wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 245 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Christ the Resting-Place”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. AGNES; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Je-sus! de-light-ful, charm-ing name! It spreads a fra-grance round; Jus-tice and mer-cy, truth and peace, In u-nion here are found.

lines: Justice and mercy, truth and peace,
He is our life, our joy, our strength;
He is a shade above our heads,
A light to guide our feet.
When storms arise and tempests blow,
The threatening billows cease to flow,
The thickest clouds are soon dispersed,

licence: Public domain: Benjamin Beddome died in 1795.
credits: Words by Benjamin Beddome (1717–1795), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to ST. AGNES by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
